players.product: AI cluster design/integration & managed services (plus Smart Modular memory)

quarterly_data.signal: Penguin Solutions' 10-K names its semiconductor suppliers as including memory manufacturers Samsung Semiconductor, Micron Technology, SK hynix, International Business Machines and Kioxia, processor providers Intel and TD SYNNEX, and networking supplier Juniper Networks; its contract manufacturers include NEC, Advantech and Celestica, and its HPC and AI clusters are manufactured and tested at its Fremont, California facility. Purchases from its two largest suppliers (not named) were $0.6 billion, $0.4 billion and $0.5 billion in 2025, 2024 and 2023.
quarterly_data.figure: purchases from two largest suppliers $0.6 billion (2025), $0.4 billion (2024), $0.5 billion (2023)

quarterly_data.signal: As of August 29, 2025 Penguin Solutions expected to recognize $73.9 million of its $89.9 million deferred revenue balance (amounts received from customers in advance of satisfying performance obligations) in the next 12 months.
quarterly_data.figure: deferred revenue $89.9 million, $73.9 million within 12 months (August 29, 2025)
